corpus: CSTR VCTK Corpus: English Multi-speaker Corpus for CSTR Voice Cloning Toolkit (version 0.92)
publisher: University of Edinburgh, Centre for Speech Technology Research
use: Public speech fixtures for local model validation; not bundled application audio.

modifications.*-clean.wav: Reference speech served by the TF-Restormer authors; the hash identifies their exact downloaded WAV.
modifications.*-input.wav: The authors' 16 kHz-to-48 kHz degraded-input demo; the hash identifies their exact downloaded WAV.
modifications.*-noisy.wav: Generated locally from clean speech by tools/validate_neural_audio.py using seeded mathematical fan, hiss and typing-like noise; not an upstream download.
modifications.*-reference.wav: The same clean speech scaled to preserve headroom for the generated noise fixture.
